page.layout: One column of contents, centred under a woodcut ornament at the top; numbered entries I to VIII, with a large decorative initial R beside entry I; signature at bottom left, catchword at bottom right.
page.notes: The woodcut ornament at the top and the decorative initial R are not text and are not transcribed. Faint show-through from the reverse page appears at the right margin and is ignored. The scan edge at the right is ignored.
